$comment: Output contract for TOOL-MKT-01 (PREDICTION_MARKET_READER) in calls_for_tools/OBSERVE_PANEL.yaml (schema: libertas.observe-panel.v1, panel: OBSERVE, execution_mode: DRY_RUN, default_behavior: READ_ONLY). Source: Unmanned_News ReadingRoom ICD203, MuseIntelligence — Renderings of Strategic Dynamics (Jesse Marshall, Nov 19, 2026), OBSERVE_PANEL.yaml expanded registry, pp. 32-33, and the MARKET_SIGNAL_IS_NOT_EVENT_EVIDENCE interdiction trigger (§3, p. 8). Required fields and hardcoded values are taken verbatim from that contract. The provenance fields source_id, source_locator and retrieval_timestamp are required by the AGENTS.md acceptance checklist (A. Provenance & Cryptographic Integrity, p. 34): every source object carries a unique source_id, stable source_locator, and UTC retrieval_timestamp; a payload lacking sourceId or sourceLocator triggers INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE and routes to quarantine.md. confidence_weight (optional, must be 0.0) comes from the same trigger's disposition, which sets confidence weight to 0.0. tool_id (optional) identifies the producing tool. The example below is illustrative only — all values use the reserved example.invalid domain and are not a real market.
description: Read-only sentiment snapshot produced by TOOL-MKT-01 from a prediction-market or tokenized Treasury yield feed. Invariant: market_probability = crowd sentiment snapshot; NEVER event evidence.

confidence_weight.description: Optional. When present, must be 0.0 — the MARKET_SIGNAL_IS_NOT_EVENT_EVIDENCE disposition (RuleCHAIN.md §3) sets confidence weight to 0.0 for market signals.

epistemic_tag.description: Hardcoded by TOOL-MKT-01. Market probability is a crowd sentiment snapshot, never event evidence.

graph_mutation_authorized.description: Hardcoded false by TOOL-MKT-01. A market-sentiment envelope can never authorize a graph mutation.

human_review_required.description: Hardcoded true by TOOL-MKT-01. Human review is required before any use beyond a sentiment overlay.

implied_probability_float.description: Implied probability extracted from the market snapshot (0.0-1.0). Crowd sentiment only — NEVER event evidence.

liquidity_depth_usd.description: Liquidity depth in USD at snapshot time, as reported by the provider.

market_id.description: Identifier of the prediction market as reported by the provider. Recorded by TOOL-MKT-01 via read_public_snapshot.

provider_locator.description: Locator of the provider and market as recorded by TOOL-MKT-01 via record_provider_and_time.

retrieval_timestamp.description: UTC retrieval timestamp. Required by the AGENTS.md acceptance checklist (A. Provenance & Cryptographic Integrity).

snapshot_timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the public snapshot read by TOOL-MKT-01.

source_id.description: Immutable identifier for this envelope. Required by the AGENTS.md acceptance checklist (A. Provenance & Cryptographic Integrity): every source object carries a unique source_id.

source_locator.description: Stable locator for the source snapshot. Required by the same checklist rule as source_id; a payload lacking sourceId or sourceLocator triggers INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE and routes to quarantine.md.

title: Market Sentiment Envelope
